experiment: E4 birth-code uniqueness and one number per pair
a_setup: Shape 13x9x3. Pair 1 along x from (6,4,1) with detectors at 3 links; pair 2 along y from the same Node and tick (collision) or from (7,4,1) (control, distinct birth code). Settings A1=0, A2=0, B1=8, B2=8. 1024 seeds each.
a_prediction_theory: E(A1,B1) = E(A2,B2) = -0.707; every cross correlation (A1,A2), (B1,B2), (A1,B2), (A2,B1) = 0 within 3 sigma; registry numbers consumed = 2 per world, two different numbers.
a_prediction_implementation: Collision: origin_bond gives all four rays one code, so the registry sees one bond asked four times in sorted Node order A1 (3,4,1), A2 (6,1,1), B2 (6,7,1), B1 (9,4,1): A1 opens, A2 is answered as the second end (E(A1,A2) = -1 at equal settings), B2 opens the same bond again with the same number (E(A1,B2) = +1), B1 answers as its second end (E(B2,B1) = -1); numbers = 2 but identical values. Control: theory values.
a_pass: control matches the theory; collision reported as an implementation limit if it deviates
b_setup: Replay. Bob's plus detector at 5 links; a second bonded detector with Alice's setting sits one link past her plus detector (the minus detector one further). A ray Alice's plus detector leaves meets the replay detector at tick 4, before Bob asks at tick 5. 1024 seeds. Variant: the replay detector at a different setting (16).
b_prediction: Same end, same setting: cached answer (-1 again), numbers stays 1 per world, questions = 2 + [Alice's first answer was -1], Bob's correlation with Alice's first answer -0.707. Different setting: the registry treats it as the second end and releases the pair, Bob then opens a new pair with the same number: numbers = 2, reported as the registry's stated limit. Direct registry API: draw repeated with identical arguments consumes no number.
b_pass: numbers == 1 and replay outcome == first outcome in every world of the same-setting variant
c_setup: Bob's detectors removed, open boundary; Bob's ray escapes. 1024 seeds, with the (absent) Bob setting parameter 8 and 24, and the full world at the same seeds.
c_prediction: Alice's plus rate 0.5 within 3 sigma (sigma 0.0156), identical pair by pair between the two Bob-setting values and identical to Alice's outcome in the full world (she asks first there by Node order); numbers == 1, open pairs == 1 and escaped quanta == 1 per world.
